look_here_first: White papery petals and blue-gray spiny foliage only establish pricklypoppy. For this eastern-Texas subspecies, check pale yellow fresh latex, relatively short usually unarmed sepal horns about 4–6(–10) mm, and narrow capsules with simple unequal prickles mostly shorter than those of A. aurantiaca. White flowers alone do not separate these species.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Robust, erect, spiny herb; stems sparsely to moderately prickly.

key_traits.label: Foliage
key_traits.text: Conspicuously glaucous; basal/proximal leaves deeply lobed nearly to the midrib.

key_traits.label: Leaf prickles
key_traits.text: Upper surface often unarmed or only sparsely prickly; lower surface prickly especially along major veins.

key_traits.label: Latex
key_traits.text: Light to pale yellow when fresh.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Large white flower; petals white; numerous lemon-yellow stamens.

key_traits.label: Bud sepals
key_traits.text: Sepal horns about 4–6(-10) mm; typically unarmed or only sparingly prickly near the base.

key_traits.label: Capsule
key_traits.text: Usually narrowly ellipsoid; longer prickles widely spaced and mixed with numerous shorter unequal prickles; longest prickles much shorter than in A. aurantiaca.

key_traits.label: Flowering
key_traits.text: Early spring through summer; fruiting spring through fall.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Fresh latex is pale/light yellow; A. aurantiaca is orange to reddish-orange.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Mature capsule prickles are mostly simple and much shorter; longest about 6–10(-12) mm.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Sepal horns are about 4–6(-10) mm and usually unarmed or only sparingly prickly near the base.

lookalikes.differences: A. aurantiaca usually has orange-red sap, prickly 8–12 mm sepal horns, and much longer often branched fruit prickles (15–35 mm). A. polyanthemos has a typically unarmed upper leaf surface, longer rounded usually unarmed sepal horns, and spaced fruit prickles. A. sanguinea can also have white petals; inspect bud and fruit, not just corolla color.
